subject: Mythology
title: Brahma: The Creator
description: A micro-lesson that makes Brahma: The Creator usable.

hook.text: Brahma created the entire universe, yet he is the least worshipped of all Hindu gods today.

buildup.text: He was born from a golden lotus that grew from Vishnu's navel while Vishnu slept on a cosmic ocean.

discovery.text: With four heads facing every direction, Brahma spoke the Vedas into existence and shaped all living things.

twist.text: He lied to win a contest with Vishnu, and Shiva cursed him, saying humanity would rarely worship him again.

climax.text: Only one major temple in all of India is dedicated to Brahma — in Pushkar, Rajasthan.

punchline.text: The god who made everything was forgotten by what he made.

quiz.question: Why is Brahma rarely worshipped in India today?
options: He retired after creation was complete
Shiva cursed him for telling a lie during a contest
Vishnu replaced him as the supreme creator
